morbi.headline: Morbi ceramic exports plunge due to Iran conflict amid rising propane and infrastructure pressures.
what_changed: Ceramic exports dropped by Rs 3,589 crore over six months due to the Iran war.
Industrial propane gas prices rose by Rs 3 to reach Rs 104 per kg.
Kajaria Ceramics acquired a 19.77% stake in Sunsure Solar Park Twenty One for ₹1.21 crore.
stress_signals: Iran war impacts led to a massive Rs 3,589 crore drop in ceramic exports [19f71f3185bc].
Escalating propane prices (up by Rs 3 to Rs 104/kg) cloud tile makers' recovery [3d9aa30057b8, 9e8c549b7c05].
Overall export outlook remains weak despite shipments to the Gulf resuming [c2b4a2f5422a].
improvement_signals: Propane usage has resumed in the Morbi ceramic cluster [3d9aa30057b8].
Ceramic shipments from Morbi to the Gulf have resumed [c2b4a2f5422a].
Kajaria Ceramics invested ₹1.21 crore in a solar energy stake [a2787358932e].
what_to_watch: Monitor working capital utilization and debt servicing for export-oriented units facing revenue contractions.
Track further movements in industrial propane and gas input prices impacting operating margins.
Assess resolution of local infrastructure, power, and water representations submitted to the district minister.

surat.headline: Severe weaving liquidity squeeze and production cuts contrast festive demand in lab-grown diamonds.
what_changed: Sayan weavers announced a collective 15-day vacation cutting fabric output by 60 crore meters amid financial crisis.
Textile trade credit conditions worsened with dues exceeding 200 days, triggering protests and police intervention.
Diamond cluster shows divergence: 100,000 downturn job losses reported alongside pre-Diwali demand keeping cutting units active.
Embroidery labor agitation concluded via owner agreement, while PLI scheme turnover limits were halved and extended to FY 2033-34.
stress_signals: Sayan weaving units cutting 60 crore meters of fabric via collective vacation to combat economic distress [297b184838d2].
Weavers protesting unpaid dues exceeding 200 days ahead of Diwali, alongside mounting SMA warnings of a trade payment crisis [774ba602b06e, e0787797133b].
Disputes between traders and weavers escalating to police complaints, including fraud cases by external buyers [f699b1f05b5e, 9a8429b49c99, 80f44f3f370f].
Diamond manufacturing hub reported 100,000 job losses amid ongoing sector downturn [1bcd949a2599].
improvement_signals: Surat lab-grown diamond units reporting increased festive demand, leading to 10% worker bonuses, with cutting units running through Dhanteras [751cd1661531, e533595d0815].
Embroidery sector labor strike resolved following a formal agreement between unit owners and labor unions [3a495ae0b3ee].
Government halved turnover thresholds and extended the textile PLI scheme through FY 2033-34, easing eligibility [c7ee55f3effe].
what_to_watch: Monitoring elongation of debtor days and working capital cycle stretch beyond 200 days in weaving and trading loan portfolios.
Cash flow strain and utilization spikes in Sayan powerloom borrowers during the planned 15-day output curtailment.
Post-Dhanteras operational continuity and export order trends in cutting/polishing diamond units versus reported downturn layoffs.
Follow-through orders and trade receivable security for fabric dispatches to outstation buyer hubs like Ahmedabad.
